name: Knapp 2018 - Yield Stability in Organic and Conservation Agriculture
description: Validation against Knapp & van der Heijden (2018) Nature Communications 9:3632. Meta-analysis of temporal yield stability comparing organic vs conventional farming (Ponisio subset, 39 studies) and no-till vs conventional tillage (Pittelkow subset, 154 studies). NOTE: This dataset uses TEMPORAL STABILITY metrics -- yield mean and SD are calculated ACROSS YEARS within each study, not across replicates within a single year.
intervention: Organic farming (Ponisio subset) or No-tillage (Pittelkow subset)
control: Conventional farming with synthetic inputs (Ponisio) or Conventional tillage (Pittelkow)
primary_outcomes: Crop yield (mean across years, various units)
Yield CV across years (relative temporal variability)
typical_effect_size: Organic ~15% lower yield than conventional; No-till ~2-3% lower yield; Organic ~15% lower yield stability (higher CV ratio)
important_moderators: Crop type (cereals, oil crops, vegetables, etc.)
extraction_priorities: 1. CRITICAL: This meta-analysis uses TEMPORAL yield data -- mean and SD are ACROSS YEARS, not across replicates
2. Extract annual yield values for treatment and control across all reported years
3. If paper reports multi-year means and SD, extract those directly
4. Record number of years of observation
5. Record number of replicates per treatment
6. Get crop species and experimental treatments (organic type, tillage type)
7. Focus on CROP YIELD as primary outcome
tc_confusion_warnings: In Ponisio subset: EXPERIMENTAL = Organic, CONTROL = Conventional
In Pittelkow subset: EXPERIMENTAL = No-till, CONTROL = Conventional tillage
Some studies have multiple crop species - extract each separately
Some studies have sub-treatments (different organic systems, different residue management)
Watch for units: Mg/ha, kg/ha, t/ha, bushels/acre

comparison.control_definition: Conventional farming (synthetic fertilizers + pesticides) or conventional tillage

ground_truth.reference: Knapp & van der Heijden (2018) Nature Communications 9:3632
ground_truth.note: yieldexp/yieldcont are mean yields ACROSS YEARS. sdexp/sdcont are SD ACROSS YEARS (temporal variability). N.Conv/N.Org (Ponisio) and repct/repnt (Pittelkow) are number of REPLICATES per year, not number of years. nryears is the number of years.
ground_truth.subsample_strategy: Select ~45 studies with highest observation counts and most complete metadata, focusing on Ponisio subset (all 39) plus 6-10 Pittelkow studies
